description: Experimental local worker agent. Version 1 reads supplied documents. Set agent_task.version=2 for decimal calculations, CSV preview/filter/numeric sort/summary/group sums, and TXT/Markdown/CSV/JSON files using approved local CPU/RAM functions. Check services.agent_tools for version 2. Up to eight tool calls, eight optional documents, 24000 input characters and three files (16000 bytes each, 24000 bytes total). Set required_artifacts to exact filenames to require delivery. No browsing, VM, cloud code runtime, arbitrary code or shell. File contents are returned in result.agent_result.artifacts. Quotes are matched; tool outputs and factual correctness are not independently verified. Shared trial quotas. Poll get_studio_job.
name: submit_agent_job
title: Delegate a task with approved tools
